checked_rules: Every number/fact traceable to document_id, page, quoted_anchor via evidence_ids.
Year-over-year comparisons explicitly state direction and magnitude (e.g., '下滑 1.20%').
Issuer self-reports are labeled as '公司披露/年报自述/公告披露'.
No historical actuals presented as conditional 'if...then...' conclusions.
